commit_message: Make ADR0125 VFX visual capture deterministic
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0125 VFX first-release requirements on current main, including explicit runtime playback state, deferred Project Rust VFX controls and copied state views, responsive background VFX compilation/file I/O in the Editor Builder, and a scrollable VFX Builder surface so preview controls and curve/gradient authoring remain reachable in constrained windows.

## Validation

Run normal Windows affected validation plus the deterministic VFX Builder visual fixture.

Visual validation target: VFX Builder Smoke template at 1.25 seconds, including preview particles, controls, module stack/properties, and curve/gradient presentation. The visual-validation feature initializes the scroll position in the first frame so the captured evidence is deterministic.
